messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the all-hands — can we get clarity on runway and immediate spend controls? Trying to prep hiring/OSS budgets for next quarter. /cc @cfo_alex

cfo_alex: Short answer: runway ~16 months at current burn; target is to get to 18 months. We need to reduce discretionary spend by ~15% over the next two quarters. Will post a short roadmap of where we expect to take action.

maria: Thanks — can you confirm if the hiring freeze is org-wide or targeted?

cfo_alex: Targeted. We are pausing most non-customer-facing hires and discretionary hiring in corporate ops. Sales, SRE/infra critical roles, and hires tied to committed customer SLAs remain approvable. All hires require an exec sponsor and finance sign-off for now.

ceo_ev: Adding: no layoffs planned. This is about pacing and prioritization, not blunt cuts to product strategy.

sam: Procurement question: any change to approval thresholds? Right now managers can approve < $10k and platform leads < $50k. Will that change?

cfo_alex: Yes — new thresholds effective immediately: managers < $3k, directors < $15k, execs < $50k. Anything > $15k will get a mandatory finance review and a 1-paragraph ROI/impact note. Updated policy linked below.

jia: :raising_hand: For vendor onboarding, will we still allow multi-year contracts with auto-renew? We've been leveraging discounts there.

finance-bot: AUTOMATION: Vendor contracts > $25k are automatically flagged for manual review. Please submit vendor onboarding checklist: /forms/vendor-onboard

taylor: Any changes to travel & expenses? I have questions about an upcoming conference trip.

cfo_alex: Travel is limited to customer-critical events and sales-critical conferences. All travel needs pre-approval in Concur with a short justification. Per-diem policy unchanged. If the trip is to demo to a prospect or support a deal, prioritize approval.

maria: Who do we loop in for procurement exceptions?

cfo_alex: Loop finance@redwood, your ops lead, and the exec sponsor. Use #procurement in Slack for fast questions and the exceptions form for formal approvals.

sam: Could finance share a tiny template for that ROI/impact note? A one-paragraph format would help managers.

cfo_alex: Will do — we'll push a template and a worked example by EOD Friday. Example header: `Subject: Procurement ROI - [Vendor]` and bullets for impact, TCO, and fallback.

jia: Thanks. Small ask: can PMs get a read-only view of committed spend so we can plan roadmaps without pinging finance constantly?

finance-bot: REPORT: Monthly committed spend dashboard published: https://dash.redwood/committed-spend. Read-only access for all employees; request deeper access via finance@redwood.

ceo_ev: Appreciate the questions. We'll run a follow-up finance AMA next Tuesday 11:00am PT to walk through the numbers and take live questions.

maria: Great — I'll collect hiring-specific questions and share a short agenda before the AMA. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
